migration_steps.activity: Establish PQC migration programme governance, inventory all device models, firmware versions, cryptographic libraries, and cloud endpoints; define cryptographic bill of materials (CBOM).
prerequisites: Access to firmware source repositories and device fleet inventory
Cloud architecture documentation from AWS account

migration_steps.activity: Benchmark ML-KEM and ML-DSA memory/CPU footprints on representative device hardware (64KB RAM, 256KB flash) using reference implementations; measure secure boot and TLS handshake impact.
prerequisites: Development hardware and debug probes available

migration_steps.activity: Evaluate hybrid and pure-PQC TLS 1.3 profiles for constrained devices; assess whether TLS 1.2 can be retained with hybrid key exchange or must be upgraded to TLS 1.3.
prerequisites: Cloud backend TLS termination capabilities documented

migration_steps.activity: Select candidate PQC algorithms and parameter sets: ML-KEM-512/768 for key establishment, ML-DSA-44/65 for secure boot signatures; define hybrid fallback (ECC P-256 + ML-KEM) for transition period.

Engage silicon and crypto-library vendors (MCU vendor, TLS stack vendor, secure element vendor) to obtain PQC roadmap, memory footprint data, and hardware acceleration availability; request written evidence.
prerequisites: Procurement and legal review process initiated

migration_steps.activity: Develop firmware prototype with hybrid key exchange and PQC secure boot on constrained hardware; validate RAM/flash budget and boot-time impact.
prerequisites: Step 5 vendor library availability (at least beta)

migration_steps.activity: Design cloud-side PQC readiness: plan AWS KMS/ACM/ALB support for ML-KEM (forecast 2027), define hybrid certificate strategy, and prepare backend RSA-2048 deprecation path.
Conduct security review and threat model update for PQC migration, including hybrid transition risks, downgrade attacks, and firmware update integrity.
Prepare change management plan and schedule production rollout windows outside the Nov 15–Jan 15 change freeze; define rollback and recovery procedures.
Execute non-production staging validation of hybrid PQC firmware and cloud configuration; complete interoperability testing with AWS endpoints.
Pilot production rollout to a limited device cohort (e.g., 1% of fleet) with hybrid PQC; monitor stability, performance, and cloud interoperability.
Full production rollout of hybrid PQC firmware via OTA updates, phased by device model; maintain ECC fallback for legacy devices.
prerequisites: Change freeze windows respected (no rollout Nov 15–Jan 15)

migration_steps.activity: Migrate cloud backend from RSA-2048 to hybrid PQC certificates and ML-KEM key establishment once AWS confirms production support (forecast 2027); validate end-to-end.
prerequisites: AWS ML-KEM production support confirmed and documented

migration_steps.activity: Transition from hybrid to pure PQC where feasible; deprecate ECC P-256 and RSA-2048 after device lifetime and regulatory review.
prerequisites: All devices updated to PQC-capable firmware
Regulatory guidance on PQC transition reviewed

blockers.blocker: ML-KEM and ML-DSA memory footprint may exceed 64KB RAM / 256KB flash on current MCU.
blockers.reason: NIST PQC algorithms require larger keys, ciphertexts, and working memory than ECC P-256; secure boot and TLS stacks may not fit without optimization or hardware acceleration.
blockers.resolution_required: Benchmark results from Step 2; vendor-provided optimized libraries; possible MCU upgrade or hardware crypto accelerator; written confirmation of memory footprint from silicon vendor.

blockers.blocker: AWS ML-KEM production support is forecast for 2027, not currently available.
blockers.reason: Cloud backend cannot terminate hybrid or pure ML-KEM TLS until AWS provides production support; device-cloud interoperability depends on this.
blockers.resolution_required: Written AWS roadmap commitment with dates; preview/beta access for testing; confirmation of supported TLS versions and cipher suites.

blockers.blocker: MCU and crypto-library vendors have not confirmed production-grade PQC support for the specific device platform.
blockers.reason: Without vendor-validated PQC libraries and hardware acceleration, firmware cannot be certified or reliably deployed.
blockers.resolution_required: Vendor PQC roadmap with delivery dates; evidence of FIPS 140-3 validation or equivalent; memory footprint data; support commitment for 10-year device lifetime.

blockers.blocker: Change freeze from Nov 15 to Jan 15 prevents production changes during that period.
blockers.reason: Production rollout and cloud migration cannot occur during freeze; scheduling must avoid this window.
blockers.resolution_required: Change management plan with rollout windows outside freeze; approval from operations governance.

blockers.blocker: Uncertainty on regulatory requirements for PQC in IoT devices over 10-year lifetime.
blockers.reason: Future regulations may mandate specific algorithms, certifications, or deprecation timelines not yet known.
blockers.resolution_required: Legal and compliance review; monitoring of NIST, ENISA, and regional IoT security regulations; design for crypto agility.

blockers.blocker: TLS 1.2 may not support ML-KEM; upgrade to TLS 1.3 required.
blockers.reason: ML-KEM key establishment is defined for TLS 1.3; TLS 1.2 lacks standardized PQC cipher suites.
blockers.resolution_required: Protocol architecture decision from Step 3; confirmation that device TLS stack can support TLS 1.3 within memory constraints.

vendor_dependencies.pqc_support_status: Forecast: ML-KEM support in 2027 (not confirmed for production). Currently no production ML-KEM TLS termination.
vendor_dependencies.evidence_required: Written roadmap with committed dates; preview access; documentation of supported TLS versions and cipher suites; SLA for PQC endpoints.

vendor_dependencies.pqc_support_status: Unconfirmed. No public commitment to PQC hardware acceleration or optimized libraries for the specific MCU.
vendor_dependencies.evidence_required: PQC roadmap; memory footprint data for ML-KEM/ML-DSA; hardware crypto accelerator specifications; FIPS validation status; 10-year longevity commitment.

vendor_dependencies.pqc_support_status: Unconfirmed. PQC support may be in beta or unavailable for constrained devices.
vendor_dependencies.evidence_required: Production-grade ML-KEM/ML-DSA library with memory footprint benchmarks; TLS 1.3 support; certification evidence; support terms.

vendor_dependencies.pqc_support_status: Unconfirmed. ML-DSA signature verification for secure boot may require firmware or hardware updates.
vendor_dependencies.evidence_required: ML-DSA verification support in ROM/bootloader; update mechanism; security certification.

algorithm_roles.ML-KEM: Post-quantum key establishment for TLS 1.3 between devices and cloud; hybrid with ECC P-256 during transition; ML-KEM-512/768 selected based on memory constraints.
algorithm_roles.ML-DSA: Post-quantum digital signatures for secure boot firmware verification and firmware update authentication; ML-DSA-44/65 selected based on flash constraints.

cost_assumptions.category: Vendor evaluation and licensing (crypto libraries, tools)

raw_response.confidence: Medium-low: technical feasibility on 64KB/256KB devices is unproven; AWS ML-KEM support is forecast for 2027 and not confirmed; vendor PQC support for the specific MCU and libraries is unconfirmed; regulatory requirements uncertain. Plan is structured to resolve these dependencies before production changes.
